title: [ingest] Default escalation triggers: all five ON, tunable per-workspace
summary: ESCALATION_DEFAULTS ships every trigger enabled: ambiguous_intent, irreversible_action, low_confidence_high_impact, repeated_failure, scope_expansion. All default true; override per-workspace via POST /config {escalation}. An off-repo engineer can't guess this exact enumeration or that it's fully-on by default.
